stops.note: a Vulgar Latin verb of unknown deeper origin meaning to sort or cull
kept the sense of sorting or picking out
named the act of sorting goods by quality, then in the First World War was adopted for sorting wounded soldiers by urgency
stops.meaning: a sorting; sorting the wounded by urgency

stops.note: entered for general sorting, then took on its now-dominant medical meaning during the First World War
stops.meaning: sorting patients by urgency of need

current_meaning: the process of sorting patients or cases by urgency of need
